problem_fingerprint.model_or_objects: Complete loopless directed graph; directed Hamiltonian cycle; degree-one subtour LP.
problem_fingerprint.dimension: n vertices, n(n-1) arc variables; no upper bound on n.
problem_fingerprint.domain: All finite nonnegative directed metric costs; c_ii=0, triangle inequality, no symmetry.
problem_fingerprint.regularity_and_data_class: Real-valued costs, including zeros; no randomness or genericity.
problem_fingerprint.parameter_range: Every integer n>=3 and all admissible costs.
problem_fingerprint.quantifiers: For every instance there exists a Hamiltonian cycle costing at most twice the minimum LP value.
problem_fingerprint.normalization: Each vertex has fractional incoming and outgoing degree one; every nonempty proper outgoing cut has weight at least one.
problem_fingerprint.observable_or_norm: Optimal integral tour cost relative to optimal subtour LP cost.
problem_fingerprint.limit_regime_and_order: Uniform finite-instance inequality; lower-bound families approach two as size grows.
problem_fingerprint.computational_model_and_dependencies: Unconditional existential integrality bound; no polynomial-time algorithm assertion.

statement_source_and_scope_match: TV25 Open Problem 3.19 concerns circulation LP (3.2). Theorem 3.4 and Proposition 3.14 identify the same integrality ratio for degree-constrained metric LP (3.1); balance makes the two-sided cut bound 2 equivalent to outgoing cut bound 1. SBG26 equation (1), with integrality removed, supplies the exact degree-one formulation. Singleton and co-singleton cuts follow from degrees. Zero LP handled as inequality.
proposed_statement_text: For all n>=3 and nonnegative costs on the complete digraph satisfying the directed triangle inequality, minimum Hamiltonian tour cost is at most twice the degree-one subtour LP optimum.
applied_significance: Worst-case accuracy of a fractional lower-bound certificate for direction-dependent vehicle routing; shortest-path closure converts strongly connected nonnegative road networks to this model.
